thread:
evan: Heads-up, I'm submitting a micro-PR to refactor the optimize/toolkit prefetch section into a single flow + add a compact JS streaming snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4750
mira: Love that. Please call out the model compatibility: prefetch requires a manifest served by the model variant. Link to model-catalog note?
tony: Also add the common tuning guidance: batch.size vs max_concurrent_requests — can cause starved batches if both are tiny.
evan: Draft JS example in the PR:
```js
// promise-based stream
const s = await client.streamGenerate({
  model: 'cedar-prefetch-2026',
  input: 'Summarize',
  prefetch: true,
  batch: { size: 6, max_concurrent_requests: 3 }
});
for await (const ch of s) console.log(ch.text);
```
mira: Nice. For prose prefer `batch.size` notation. Also add a one-line curl fallback for non-SDK users.
